title: 第十七章 于皇后第十八章 终于来了
slug: 根骨被毁我逆袭成准帝
lines: 在她眼前，变成黑色大蛇的蛇妖蚀骨身后盘旋着一条黑色巨蟒，目光森然，毒牙雪亮，蛇信吞吐间，一滴滴毒液滴落下来，寒气一点一点在蚀骨的蛇身上凝结。
此妖大补！
孟婵玥感受到金色液体对蚀骨妖身的渴望，下一瞬间，隐匿在金钉下的金色液体变成细细的金丝，延着她的后背往上蔓延，最后溢满她的眼眶。
近了近了，眼看蚀骨的蛇首就要挨到到孟婵玥的头顶，一双黑色的铁爪朝她抓了过来。
蚀骨躲闪不及，铁爪划过她的黑色鳞片，火花四溅，在上面留下两道爪痕。
“守山，你尽然敢坏我好事！”
蚀骨化作人形，脸颊上出现了两道血痕。
守山站在孟婵玥身前，妖冶的脸上透出几分冷冽。
“你不能动她！”
坐在首位的庄拓看到守山及时救下孟婵玥，心里松了口气，随即又有一些不快，原本该是他亲自救下孟婵玥才对。
蚀骨自知不是守山的对手，不再上前攻击孟婵玥，而是将目光投向孟婵玥身旁的二丫。
“你跟前的不能动，那这个总能动了吧！”
话音未落，她已经闪身来到二丫跟前，身形直接化作黑色大蛇朝二丫缠过去。
孟婵玥见机，一把将二丫推开，手里握着黑木簪刺过去。随着她的动作，有金色的液体从她指尖流出，在黑木簪尖端凝结成细细的一点。
蚀骨的蛇首一靠近，就被黑木簪刺中嘴巴上的鳞片。
她觉得受伤处像是被火烫了一下，灼烧的厉害，直接化作人形闪到一边。
她怒气冲冲地瞪着孟婵玥，从袖中取出一个小镜子查看。只见唇角出现了一个肉色的小坑，像是被什么东西融去了一块肉。
“你该死！”
蚀骨大怒，浑身寒气凝结，化作锋利的坚冰。
“蚀骨，住手！”
坐在上首的庄拓见孟婵玥在面对蚀骨的时候，脸上没有任何惧色，还用那支熟悉的黑木簪刺伤了蚀骨，眼底不由露出赞赏之色。
蚀骨听到庄拓的命令，气呼呼地坐到夜冥身旁，抢了她手里的酒喝。
“气死本王了，主人竟然护着那个伤害过他的人族女子！”
“不就是长得白了点，眼睛大了点吗？其余的地方本王哪里比不过！”
夜冥用柔弱无骨的手撑着下巴，听到蚀骨的话，碧绿的猫眼懒懒地看过来，嘴角勾起一抹笑。
“她就是你们前段时间和国师一起从南梁带过来的那一位三公主吧。”
”听说她的根骨是国师亲手毁的。”
“只是我看她方才对战你的样子，一点儿也不害怕，还伤到你了呢！”
content_en:
In front of her eyes, a giant black python was hovering behind the snake monster that had turned into a big black snake. Its eyes were stern and its fangs were sharp. As the snake swallowed, droplets of venom dripped down, and the cold air condensed on the body of the snake bit by bit.
This monster is a great supplement!
Meng Chanyue felt the golden liquid's desire for the bone-corroding demon's body. In the next moment, the golden liquid hidden under the golden nails turned into thin golden threads, spreading up her back and finally overflowing her eyes.
As she got closer, she saw that the bone-corroding snake head was about to touch the top of Meng Chanyue's head, and a pair of black iron claws grabbed at her.
Nao Gu couldn't dodge, and the iron claws scratched her black scales, causing sparks to fly and leaving two claw marks on it.
"Shoushan, how dare you ruin my good deeds!"
The bones turned into a human form, and two blood marks appeared on the cheeks.
Shoushan stood in front of Meng Chanyue, with a cold look on his charming face.
"You can't touch her!"
Zhuang Tuo, who was sitting in the first place, felt relieved when he saw Shoushan rescuing Meng Chanyue in time, but then felt a little unhappy. He should have saved Meng Chanyue himself.
"Hmph!"
Xianggu knew that he was no match for Shou Shan, so he no longer stepped forward to attack Meng Chanyue, but instead turned his attention to Erya beside Meng Chanyue.
"The one in front of you can't move, so this one can move!"
Before she finished speaking, she had already ducked in front of Erya and turned into a big black snake to wrap around Erya.
Seeing the opportunity, Meng Chanyue pushed Erya away and stabbed Erya with the black wooden hairpin in her hand. As she moved, golden liquid flowed from her fingertips and condensed into a thin point at the tip of the black wooden hairpin.
As soon as the bone-eroded snake head came closer, the black wood hairpin pricked the scales on its mouth.
"Hiss..."
She felt as if the injured area had been scalded by fire. The burning was so severe that she turned into a human form and stepped aside.
She glared at Meng Chanyue angrily, took out a small mirror from her sleeve and looked at it. A small flesh-colored pit appeared at the corner of his lips, as if a piece of flesh had been melted away by something.
"You deserve to die!"
Nao Gu was furious, and the cold air condensed all over his body, turning into sharp ice.
"Bones, stop!"
Zhuang Tuo, who was sitting at the top, saw that Meng Chanyue showed no fear on her face when facing the bone erosion, and even stabbed the bone erosion with the familiar black wood hairpin, and he couldn't help but show admiration in his eyes.
"Yes!"
After hearing Zhuang Tuo's order, Xianggu angrily sat down next to Ye Ming and snatched the wine from her hand.
"I am so angry that my master actually protected the human woman who hurt him!"
"Isn't it just that she looks a bit whiter and her eyes are a bit bigger? I can't compare to you in other places!"
Ye Ming propped up his chin with his weak, boneless hands. When he heard Ru Gu's words, his green cat eyes looked over lazily, with a smile on his lips.
"She must be the third princess you brought over from Nanliang with the Imperial Master some time ago."
"I heard that her bones were destroyed by the Imperial Master himself."
"It's just that when I saw her fighting you just now, she wasn't afraid at all, and she even hurt you!"
